newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 1.27 pct Dec 16-Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 1.27 pct Dec 16-Jan 15.

text.p: Brazilian inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) rose 1.27 percent in the Dec 16-Jan 15 period, compared to 0.78 percent in the previous four-week period, a Fipe official said.

Transport prices accounted for most of the gain, rising 5.23 percent in the period, said Fipe President Juarez Rizzieri. He said education costs also contributed to the slightly higher Dec 16-Jan 15 figure, noting school costs rose 4.89 percent in the period.
Rizzieri said he expected the Fipe index, which measures price growth in the greater Sao Paulo metropolitan area, to close January at about 1.0 percent.
